gate: Require different top classes, current top class appears in vibration top-2, vibration top1-top2 <= vibration_margin_max, current top confidence >= current_confidence_min, current top1-top2 >= current_margin_min; if selected pair is non-null also require that directed pair.
fusion: On gate only: fused=(1-current_weight)*vibration_probability+current_weight*current_probability. Otherwise use vibration_probability. Choose argmax; ties use first class index.
